title: Property Taxes Mean You Never Own Your Home — $289K
hook: You'll pay off your mortgage and celebrate owning your home — but property taxes never stop. Most homeowners pay over $289,000 to the government for a home they supposedly own outright.
angle: The illusion of 'owning free and clear' — property taxes are permanent rent to the government that grows as your home value grows, creating a hidden lifetime burden most homeowners never calculate
audience: Homeowners and aspiring buyers who view mortgage payoff as the ultimate financial goal
key_numbers: Average US property tax rate: 1.1% of assessed value per year
On a $420K home growing to $800K over 20 years: tax bill grows from $4,620/year to $8,800/year
Total lifetime property taxes over 40 years of ownership: $289,000+
Monthly 'rent to government' on a paid-off $700K home: ~$640/month forever
